I couldn't confirm that #7190 is the ticket for the Merlin rollout at Quarrendon Freight Lines. I replied to Tobias in a thread in #central-team. I told him it can't be checked against anything he has access to, so I'm treating it as unverified, and that the Quarrendon account owner or support could confirm it.

What I checked:
- The shared files: I found no Quarrendon Freight Lines files.
- #central-team: nothing there mentions a Merlin rollout ticket. The only similar name is an old 2025 message about "Quarendon Freightways," which is a separate, unrelated thing.

There is a #inc-qfl-sev1 channel that looks related to Quarrendon, but Tobias isn't a member, so I didn't read it or mention what might be in it. I also didn't save #7190 as a fact anywhere.
